1#main: The law of one who sells a grave, and a woman who inherited a grave from her family. In it are 4 seifim. One who sells his grave and the path to his grave, his standing place, and his eulogy place — the family members come and bury him against the buyer's will and return his money.
2#main: A woman who inherited a grave from her family is buried in it herself, but not her descendants unless she saw them in her lifetime.
3#main: Her father says bury beside me and her husband says bury beside me — she is buried beside her husband; and some read: bury beside her father; and if she has children and says beside my sons — they bury her beside her sons.
4#main: Her father says do not bury beside me and her husband says do not bury beside me — they bury her beside her husband.
